children: Frgmnt co-founder and CEO Aurélien Roussel said fiat-backed stablecoins cannot fully escape risks tied to traditional banks, despite being blockchain-based assets. According to Odaily, Roussel said stablecoins are shifting from DeFi tools toward infrastructure for accessing U.S. dollars, with broader adoption depending on making blockchain technology nearly invisible to end users.

He cited bank failures in 2023 as evidence that fiat-backed stablecoins remain dependent on the traditional banking system and exposed to bank counterparty risks. Roussel said Tether remains dominant in non-Western global trade because of its liquidity, exchange support, merchant acceptance and distribution network. He added that local rules such as MiCA are prompting issuers to build compliant infrastructure in their markets.

Roussel said Layer 2 networks have reduced stablecoin transaction costs to less than one cent. He expects competition among issuers to focus on distribution, liquidity and financial services, as stablecoins expand from payment tools into programmable, yield-generating capital. He said central bank digital currencies and private stablecoins are more likely to coexist.

title: Frgmnt Co-Founder Aurélien Roussel Says Stablecoins Cannot Escape Traditional Bank Risks
